parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the DTS task. The DTS task can be a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: DtsJobName
parameters.description:
The new name of the DTS task.

>  We recommend that you specify a descriptive name for easy identification. You do not need to use a unique name.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Whether it is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) task, the value can be:
- **false**: No. - **true**: Yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-dts-job-name --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-job-name 'RDS间迁移' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aekzfkjjb5gyy6i --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ModifyDtsJobName --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzfkjjb5gyy6i' --ZeroEtlJob true --DtsJobName 'RDS间迁移' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
